title: 空間情報工学
subtitle: Geoinformatics
educationalGoal: A variety of spatial information is necessary for environmental management of the earth and its regions. Students will acquire basic knowledge on geospatial information engineering, and technology for collecting, accumulating, and analyzing geospatial information.
advice:
This class focuses on remote sensing, geographic information systems, and 3D mapping in spatial information engineering. In recent years, environmental problems such as global environmental problems have attracted attention, and it is desirable to grasp changes in the environment. Remote sensing technology is a technology suitable for analyzing satellite data and monitoring the environment over a wide area. A geographic information system is a means of storing, searching, and analyzing geographic information. 3D mapping is used for advanced navigation systems and augmented reality technologies. The lectures match the basic materials that are distributed. We provide a wealth of examples such as remote sensing images and explain them using PowerPoint presentations. In addition, in order to deepen our knowledge, we conduct exercises using computers.
For exercises, students use software such as EISEI, Google Earth, Google Map, SKETCHUP, etc.
Special lectures will be held by invited representatives from companies that are making use of these technologies.
requiredKnowledge:
Students must be familiar with the concepts from Surveying 1 and Surveying 2. During the exercises, students need to bring a laptop computer that can connect to the Internet on campus. Materials and data used in the class will be distributed in the teaching material distribution system.
Use of private language in class is strictly prohibited.
